translations.web: For this cause I also, when I couldn’t stand it any longer, sent that I might know your faith, for fear that by any means the tempter had tempted you, and our labor would have been in vain.
translations.bsb: For this reason, when I could bear it no longer, I sent to find out about your faith, for fear that the tempter had somehow tempted you and that our labor might have been in vain.
translations.kjv: For this cause, when I could ➔ no longer forbear, I sent to know your faith, lest by some means the tempter have tempted you, and our labour be in vain.
translations.asv: For this cause I also, when I could no longer forbear, sent that I might know your faith, lest by any means the tempter had tempted you, and our labor should be in vain.
